note: Balloon Take Away (subtraction within 9). English only. Questions q1-q10 are shuffled at runtime, so each question carries its own voice key.

lines.text: Here are five balloons. Let's count.
One, two, three. Three balloons left.
The minus sign means take away.
Five take away two equals three.
Listen. Three balloons. One flew away. How many left? Tap the right number.
